units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:9">Targ. Prov. VII, 9</cite> <he>מַעֲרַב יומא</he> (h. text <he>ערב יום</he>).
Targ. Gen. XXVIII, 14; a. fr.—In Talmud Babli מ׳ the West, Palestine.

<cite ref="Yevamot 117a">Yeb. 117ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:1">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> <he>במ׳ אמרי</he>, read <he>במְעַרְבָּבַיָּא</he>, v. <cite ref="P01261"><he>עַרְבֵּב</he></cite>.]—[<cite ref="Sotah 41b:8">Sot. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>בר מ׳</he> prob. pr. n. m.]
